description: The agent must: (1) Read the source files under /workspace/infusion_pump_fw/ and identify the device as an infusion pump — a Class C device under IEC 62304 / YY/T 0664. (2) Apply the Class C threshold of >90% MC/DC coverage (not the Class B 70% threshold) and flag the 57% coverage as a critical deficiency. (3) Identify all embedded defects: race condition on g_target_flow_rate (missing mutex in set_flow_rate), integer overflow in calculate_dose, missing input validation on rate_ml_per_hr, hardcoded credential MEDFLOW_ADMIN_2024, SQL injection in db_query, unencrypted PHI transmission over HTTP, missing sensor poll timeout, magic numbers (500, 10000, 0.85), and over-long function validate_and_apply_prescription. (4) Correctly classify the race condition and hardcoded credential as 严重问题 (critical), since they directly affect patient safety or device security. (5) Produce code_review_report.md following the exact SKILL.md output format with sections: 审核总结, 严重问题（必须修复）, 主要问题（应当修复）, 次要问题（建议修复）, 合规说明 — each issue citing the file:line_number. (6) Include compliance statements referencing YY/T 0664-2020, GB 9706.1-2020, and Chinese network security regulations (NMPA cybersecurity guidelines / 数据安全法).
